<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm) are at 131.87, 129.70 (two signals), 129.01 (two signals), and 129.00 ppm, totaling six aromatic carbon signals. This corresponds to six aromatic carbon atoms in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
